items.title: De'Anthony Melton's contract with the Warriors came in higher than was reported. Melton got the full Taxpayer MLE:
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
De'Anthony Melton's contract with the Warriors came in higher than was reported. Melton got the full Taxpayer MLE:

2026-27: $6.064M
2027-28: $6.4M

2027-28 is a player option for Melton. GSW is hard-capped at the second apron by using the Tax MLE. GSW has ~$5.2M in room under the second apron.
